purpose: Naxosv2 is the course-builder/source-of-truth. Evia should consume simplified learner-facing main tasks while Naxos retains the detailed course mapping underneath.

principles.gapHandling: Uncovered KSB/facets are surfaced later as gap/top-up evidence rather than forcing every atomic element to be a learner-facing task.
principles.assessment: Learner collects evidence; assessor decides whether it meets the mapped criteria.

eviaCaptureContract.entry: Tapping a main task opens photo capture directly. There is no intermediate Start evidence page.

photoScreen.topQuarter: Evia in the top-left with a speech bubble containing one natural sentence explaining the useful evidence to capture for the selected main task.
photoScreen.photoCount: Flexible photo dump; encourage a natural start-to-finish story rather than one photo per KSB.
photoScreen.guidanceRule: Photo guidance covers only what can be shown visually.

afterPhotos.title: What else is shown?
afterPhotos.rule: Learner selects only extra areas genuinely visible/demonstrated in the evidence.

explanation.rule: The Explain requirement is separate from the photo sequence and carries dynamically into the Written/Audio screen.
